s: The God of all comfort comforts us in our troubles. Paul explains his change of plans.
Forgive the one who caused pain. We are the aroma of Christ.
The new covenant of the Spirit gives life. We reflect the glory of the Lord.
We have this treasure in earthen vessels.
Our earthly tent and heavenly dwelling. In Christ we are a new creation, and God gives us the ministry of reconciliation.
Now is the day of salvation. Paul's hardships as a minister of God.
Paul rejoices that his letter led the Corinthians to repentance.
The example of the Macedonian churches' generosity.
Paul defends his authority against his critics.
Paul's sufferings for Christ, against the false apostles.
Paul's vision of paradise and his thorn in the flesh: my grace is sufficient for you.
Final warnings and greetings, with a blessing of the Trinity.

6: The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
